title: Senegal's ousted PM Sonko re-elected head of his political party
summary: Ousmane Sonko, who was sacked as Senegal's prime minister after a falling-out with President Bassirou Diomaye Faye, was re-elected Saturday as head of his Pan-African Pastef party.
